copy.text: Check tire condition and cold pressure against the vehicle placard.
Test headlights, brake lights, turn signals, hazards, wipers, washers and glass-clearing functions.
Check coolant and washer-fluid requirements in the manual.
Check the forecast and road authority advice before a trip.
